vision.title: Software should respect you.
vision.p1: In an era of endless notifications, subscription fatigue, and data harvesting, we take a different approach.
vision.p2: At IFUIX, we believe tools should empower you, not distract you. We build software that gets out of your way so you can do your best work.
vision.f1_desc: No telemetry, no tracking pixels, no selling data.
vision.f2_desc: Native performance that doesn't keep you waiting.
vision.f3_desc: No subscriptions. You buy it, you own it forever.

featured.title: Meet Fuira
featured.desc: Our flagship desktop application designed to streamline your workflow with unparalleled speed and complete offline capability. Experience a new standard in software craftsmanship.

trust.title: Built on Trust
trust.t1_desc: Key components of our software are open source, allowing the community to verify our security and privacy claims.
trust.t2_desc: Our applications are designed to work perfectly without an internet connection. Your data stays on your device.
trust.t3_desc: We don't collect usage statistics or analytics. Your business is your business.

values.title: Core Values
values.v1_desc: We strip away the unnecessary, leaving only what's essential for your workflow.
values.v2_desc: Every pixel, animation, and line of code is carefully considered.
values.v3_desc: We respect your time, your attention, and your privacy.
values.v4_desc: We are proudly independent and answer only to our users.

founder.title: Hi, I'm Iqbal.
founder.quote: Building thoughtful software from Indonesia. I believe software should respect users' time, attention, and privacy instead of exploiting them.
founder.desc: I started IFUIX as a personal mission to build the tools I wished existed. No venture capital, no aggressive growth metrics—just a relentless focus on creating high-quality software that solves real problems elegantly.

roadmap.subtitle: What we're building and where we're going.

footer.desc: An independent software studio crafting beautiful, privacy-first applications.

about.title: About IFUIX
about.desc: We are a small, independent software studio focused on creating tools that respect your attention and privacy.
about.story_p1: IFUIX started as a rebellion against the modern software industry. We were tired of apps that required an internet connection for basic tasks, tracked every click, and charged monthly subscriptions for simple features.
about.story_p2: We believe that software should be a tool, not a service. It should empower you, run blazingly fast on your device, and keep your data yours.
about.founder_desc: Building thoughtful software from Indonesia. I started IFUIX because I was tired of tools that distract, track, and exploit users. My goal is to craft beautiful, single-purpose applications that respect your time and data.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.desc: Have a question, feedback, or just want to say hi? We'd love to hear from you.

download.subtitle: Requires Windows 10+ or macOS 12+
download.n1: Initial public beta release of Fuira.
download.n2: Core workflow features implemented: Smart Reminder, Markdown Notes, Timer.
download.n3: Google Drive Sync configured for opt-in cross-device sync.
download.n4: Fully offline capable with Local Storage.

products.title: Our Products
products.fuira_desc: The ultimate offline-first productivity suite. Manage tasks, write markdown notes, and track your focus time without distractions.

product_detail.subtitle: Fast. Private. Offline-first.

product_detail.d2: No tracking pixels, no telemetry, no analytics.
product_detail.d3: Works perfectly without an internet connection.
product_detail.d4: Minimalist interface that gets out of your way.

support.desc: Your support helps me dedicate more time to building thoughtful software that respects people's privacy and attention.
support.impact: Every contribution—no matter how small—helps improve Fuira and future products.
support.why_5: Your support allows us to keep building thoughtful software.

services.title: Custom Software Development
services.subtitle: Bringing your ideas to life with high-quality, scalable, and modern applications.
services.web_desc: Modern, responsive, and performant web applications built with the latest technologies like React, Tailwind, and Node.js. Tailored to your business needs.
services.desktop_desc: Powerful, native-feeling desktop applications for Windows and macOS. Built for speed, offline capabilities, and seamless user experience.
services.mobile_desc: Cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android. Engaging interfaces and smooth performance to reach your users wherever they are.
services.trust_desc: With a proven track record of developing complex, privacy-first software like Fuira, IFUIX brings deep technical expertise and a meticulous eye for design to every project. We don't just write code; we craft reliable products that your users will love.
services.cta_desc: Let's discuss your requirements and how we can help you build your next great product.
